data.offering_description: Designs, markets and sells branded apparel, sleepwear and accessories for babies and young children. Sells to parents through department stores, mass merchants, its own stores, online and international franchise partners, with the products sourced from contract manufacturers.

data.primary_products: baby and toddler apparel; children's sleepwear; children's outerwear; children's accessories

data.customer_segment: B2C: parents and families buying clothing for babies and young children; B2B: department stores, mass merchants, specialty and online retailers, and franchise partners

data.revenue_model: product sales: branded children's apparel sold wholesale to retailers and direct to consumers; licensing or royalties: royalties from licensed partners selling Carter's-branded products

data.value_chain_position: brand owner: designs and markets its own brands, sourcing finished goods from contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and consumers; retailer: operates its own stores and online sales, selling directly to parents

data.geography_served: global: US, Canada and Mexico directly, plus international wholesale and franchised stores in Asia, the Middle East and other regions

data.specialization: related lines: Carter's and OshKosh B'gosh brands, both selling children's apparel to the same parents and retail channels

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: wholesale sales to large retail accounts; own locations: Carter's and OshKosh retail stores across North America; third-party retail: department stores, mass merchants and specialty retailers; online: company websites and third-party online retailers; partners / resellers: international franchise partners operating stores and wholesale accounts

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: children's product safety rules such as flammability standards, lead and chemical limits from the US Consumer Product Safety Commission

P1.2.text: Visit G-III Apparel Group online to learn about our footprint as a global fashion leader with a portfolio of over 30 licensed and owned brands.

P1.3.text: As a global leader in fashion, we unlock the value of our 30+ brands through our team’s agility and innovation.

P1.4.text: We are global experts in design, sourcing, distribution and marketing, bringing excitement and confidence to customers through the fashion we create.

P1.6.text: With over 30 owned and licensed global brands in our portfolio, our strengths across the full product life cycle enable us to unlock their value and fuel growth.

P1.7.text: Marc Jacobs is an iconic American fashion house known for its fearless designs and playful approach to luxury. Since its inception the brand has created a lasting impact on the fashion industry, becoming synonymous with creativity, individuality, and timeless craftsmanship. Marc Jacobs continues to influence the world of fashion with its innovative vision and bold approach to style.

P1.8.text: When Donna Karan launched her first collection she started with a city, Seven Easy Pieces, and the power of a woman—and she revolutionized the way women dress.

P1.9.text: the House of Karl Lagerfeld shares the iconic vision and design aesthetic of its namesake, fused with a contemporary, forward-looking spirit.

P1.10.text: From the house founded by Donna Karan DKNY emerged.

P1.12.text: G-III’s success comes from our agility, drive and dedication to delivering for our customers. Every member of the team brings a unique point of view that adds something special to our company and the products we create.
